meta_description: Dalton's Gardening & Cleaning Solutions in Leeds offers expert landscape gardening, garden maintenance, and outdoor cleaning. Local, reliable, professional service.
hero_subhead: Professional landscape gardening and garden cleaning that turns overgrown plots into outdoor havens you'll love spending time in.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Outdoor Cleaning Services Leeds
services_subhead: From hedge trimming and patio cleaning to full landscape design, we handle every aspect of garden care and outdoor transformation.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, budget, and lifestyle. We'll specify plants, hard landscaping, and layout to maximise curb appeal and usability.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Seasonal Care
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming, lawn care, border maintenance, and seasonal planting keep your garden looking immaculate year-round without the hassle.

services.title: Patio & Driveway Cleaning
services.desc: High-pressure cleaning removes algae, moss, and dirt from patios, driveways, and decking, restoring them to like-new condition safely and quickly.

services.title: Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown gardens, dead trees, and accumulated debris removed and disposed of responsibly. We leave your space clean and ready for whatever comes next.

services.title: Fencing, Decking & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional installation and repair of fences, decking, raised beds, and stone features that add structure, privacy, and lasting value to your garden.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Stump Removal
services.desc: Safe felling, pruning, and stump grinding by experienced operators. We handle awkward locations and ensure proper disposal of all waste.

about_pullquote: I started Dalton's because I saw too many beautiful gardens left to rot through neglect.
about_para_1: Dalton's Gardening & Cleaning Solutions was founded on the simple principle that every outdoor space deserves expert care and attention. Based in Middleton, Leeds, we've spent over 18 years perfecting landscape design, garden maintenance, and outdoor cleaning across the city. Our team combines horticultural knowledge with practical problem-solving, whether you need a complete garden transformation or regular seasonal upkeep.
about_para_2: We're known across Leeds for honest pricing, reliable scheduling, and work that lasts. Our customers return season after season because we treat every job—from a small patio clean to a full garden redesign—with the same professionalism and care. We listen to what you want, offer practical advice, and deliver results that exceed expectations.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Our Work

reviews.text: Had a nightmare of an overgrown garden—weeds everywhere, fence falling apart. Dalton's came out, gave a fair quote, and transformed it in two weeks. The new patio looks brilliant. Really professional team, no fuss, just got on with it. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Dalton's for three years now. Monthly maintenance keeps the garden looking perfect without me lifting a finger. They're reliable, always turn up on time, and the lads take pride in their work. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Needed the patio cleaned before a big family do. Called on Tuesday, they came Wednesday and did an absolutely cracking job. Looked like brand new. Fair price too. Cheers, lads.
reviews.author: David L.
